description: This file defines a Java interface named ChangeSetExecutorCallback used for callbacks during database changelog executions in a Liquibase context, specifically within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: ChangeSetExecutorCallback
classes.description: A Java interface for callback mechanisms invoked after executing each database changeset in Liquibase within the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: executing
methods.description: Callback method invoked after each changeset execution, providing details of the executed ChangeSet and the total number of changesets to run.
